edits.after:
name: CDC independent parameter consumers

on:
  push:
    branches: [agent/cdc-independent-parameter-consumers]
  pull_request:
    branches: [parameterized-verilog]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled]
    paths:
      - 'core/src/main/scala/spinal/core/**'
      - 'morphruntime/**'
      - 'morphhdl/src/main/**'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/scala/**'
      - 'morphhdl/scripts/**'
      - 'morphhdl/contracts/**'
      - 'repro/cdc-independent-parameters/**'
      - '.github/workflows/cdc-independent-parameter-consumers.yml'
  # A commit-specific owner review can start this workflow while [skip ci]
  # continues to suppress the unrelated push/pull_request qualification fleet.
  pull_request_review:
    types: [submitted]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: Run the pinned source repair or normal targeted qualification
        type: choice
        options: [checks, source-repair]
        default: checks

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: cdc-independent-consumers-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref || github.ref_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

env:
  SBT_TEST_PARALLEL: '0'
  JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS: '-Xmx2g -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2'
  JVM_OPTS: '-Xmx4g -Xss2m -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2'
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'

jobs:
  repair-reviewed-source:
    name: Pinned PR189 source-review repair and failed source gates
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.mode == 'source-repair' && github.ref_name == 'agent/cdc-independent-parameter-consumers' && github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action == 'labeled' && github.event.label.name == 'pr189-source-repair-v1' && github.event.pull_request.number == 189 && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.head_ref == 'agent/cdc-independent-parameter-consumers' && github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request_review' && github.event.action == 'submitted' && github.event.review.state == 'commented' && github.event.review.user.login == github.repository_owner && github.actor == github.repository_owner && github.event.pull_request.number == 189 && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'agent/cdc-independent-parameter-consumers' && github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'parameterized-verilog' && github.event.review.commit_id == github.event.pull_request.head.sha && github.event.review.body == format('pr189:source-repair:{0}', github.event.pull_request.head.sha))
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive
          persist-credentials: true
      - name: Prepare only the pinned reviewed source metadata repair
        env:
          EXPECTED_INPUT: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="$RUNNER_TEMP/pr189-source-repair"
          mkdir -p "$evidence"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_INPUT"
          git rev-parse HEAD 'HEAD^{tree}' > "$evidence/input-identity.txt"
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          python3 repro/cdc-independent-parameters/repair_source_reviews.py 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/prepare.log"
          git rev-parse HEAD 'HEAD^{tree}' > "$evidence/candidate-identity.txt"
          git diff --binary "$EXPECTED_INPUT" HEAD > "$evidence/candidate.patch"
          git bundle create "$evidence/candidate.bundle" HEAD "^$EXPECTED_INPUT"
      - name: Execute the failed source gates and their rejection controls
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="$RUNNER_TEMP/pr189-source-repair"
          checks=(
            'git diff --check'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-62-wa08-source-overlay.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-62-wa08-source-overlay.py --self-test'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py --self-test'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-native-source-preservation.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-native-source-preservation.py --self-test'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-native-source-overlay.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-58-retirement.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-production-retirement.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-layering-ir.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-layering-ir.py --self-test'
            'bash morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-vec-boundary.sh'
            'python3 repro/cdc-independent-parameters/test_layering_root.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-60g-source-scope.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/test-increment-59h-inherited-source-scope.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/test-increment-59c-inherited-source-scope.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-60f-equivalence-closure.py --source-only'
          )
          failures=0
          index=0
          : > "$evidence/results.tsv"
          for check in "${checks[@]}"; do
            index=$((index + 1))
            printf '\nCHECK %s: %s\n' "$index" "$check"
            if bash -e -o pipefail -c "$check" > "$evidence/check-$index.log" 2>&1; then
              printf 'PASS\t%s\n' "$check" >> "$evidence/results.tsv"
            else
              failures=$((failures + 1))
              printf 'FAIL\t%s\n' "$check" >> "$evidence/results.tsv"
            fi
            cat "$evidence/check-$index.log"
          done
          git diff --exit-code
          git diff --cached --exit-code
          printf 'Targeted source failures: %s\n' "$failures"
          test "$failures" -eq 0
      - name: Publish only a passing source candidate without launching full CI
        env:
          EXPECTED_INPUT: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          branch='agent/cdc-independent-parameter-consumers'
          actual=$(git ls-remote --exit-code origin "refs/heads/$branch" | cut -f1)
          test "$actual" = "$EXPECTED_INPUT"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$EXPECTED_INPUT" HEAD
          # Every new commit contains [skip ci]. No force push, target update,
          # automatic merge, or full-workflow dispatch is permitted here.
          for commit in $(git rev-list "$EXPECTED_INPUT..HEAD"); do
            git show -s --format=%B "$commit" | grep -F '[skip ci]'
          done
          git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$branch"
          git rev-parse HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pr189-source-repair/published-head.txt"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: pr189-targeted-source-repair-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/pr189-source-repair/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

  source-preflight:
    name: Current-head source audit preflight
    if: >-
      (github.event_name != 'pull_request_review' && (github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' || inputs.mode != 'source-repair') && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.action != 'labeled' || github.event.label.name == 'pr189-targeted-ci-v1')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request_review' && github.event.action == 'submitted' && github.event.review.state == 'commented' && github.event.review.user.login == github.repository_owner && github.actor == github.repository_owner && github.event.pull_request.number == 189 && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'agent/cdc-independent-parameter-consumers' && github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'parameterized-verilog' && github.event.review.commit_id == github.event.pull_request.head.sha && github.event.review.body == format('pr189:checks:{0}', github.event.pull_request.head.sha))
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Collect every current-source audit failure before expensive jobs
        env:
          EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p cdc-source-evidence
          git rev-parse HEAD | tee cdc-source-evidence/head.txt
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"
          git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}' > cdc-source-evidence/tree.txt
          git merge-base --is-ancestor 27af65abbee0d2334d6be7a6e4e2408b8af32fd9 HEAD
          checks=(
            'git diff --check'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py --self-test'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-native-source-preservation.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-native-source-preservation.py --self-test'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-native-source-overlay.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-58-retirement.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-production-retirement.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-layering-ir.py'
            'python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-layering-ir.py --self-test'
            'bash morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-vec-boundary.sh'
            'python3 repro/cdc-independent-parameters/test_layering_root.py'
          )
          failures=0
          index=0
          : > cdc-source-evidence/results.tsv
          for check in "${checks[@]}"; do
            index=$((index + 1))
            printf '\nCHECK %s: %s\n' "$index" "$check"
            if bash -e -o pipefail -c "$check" > "cdc-source-evidence/check-$index.log" 2>&1; then
              printf 'PASS\t%s\n' "$check" >> cdc-source-evidence/results.tsv
            else
              failures=$((failures + 1))
              printf 'FAIL\t%s\n' "$check" >> cdc-source-evidence/results.tsv
            fi
            cat "cdc-source-evidence/check-$index.log"
          done
          git diff --exit-code
          git diff --cached --exit-code
          printf 'Current-source audit failures: %s\n' "$failures"
          test "$failures" -eq 0
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: cdc-current-source-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: cdc-source-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

  baseline-probe:
    name: Historical baseline reproduction (448dfdf; not feature qualification)
    needs: source-preflight
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/spinalhdl/docker:v1.2.0
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: 448dfdf29839bfde4f8ff1f4833f3bb01180a56d
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Reproduce historical diagnostics on the exact historical source
        env:
          EVENT_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p cdc-independent-evidence
          printf '%s\n' "$EVENT_HEAD" > cdc-independent-evidence/event-head.txt
          git rev-parse HEAD | tee cdc-independent-evidence/head.txt
          git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}' > cdc-independent-evidence/tree.txt
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 448dfdf29839bfde4f8ff1f4833f3bb01180a56d
          git merge-base --is-ancestor 7f355a859e7e88ca343e1ff82f261fb47b3311d0 HEAD
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-62-wa08-source-overlay.py
          git diff --exit-code 7f355a859e7e88ca343e1ff82f261fb47b3311d0 -- core morphruntime morphhdl frontend \
            ':(exclude)morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-62-wa08-source-overlay.py' \
            ':(exclude)morphhdl/contracts/increment-62-wa08-source-overlay.json' \
            ':(exclude)morphhdl/contracts/increment-54-typed-layering-ir.contract' \
            ':(exclude)morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-layering-ir.py'
          python3 repro/cdc-independent-parameters/test_source_review.py
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-layering-ir.py
          python3 repro/cdc-independent-parameters/test_layering_root.py
          cd repro/cdc-independent-parameters
          sbt -batch -no-colors 'runMain CdcIndependentParametersRepro /tmp/cdc-pr188-repro' 2>&1 | tee ../../cdc-independent-evidence/baseline.log
          python3 check_baseline.py ../../cdc-independent-evidence/baseline.log
          cp -a /tmp/cdc-pr188-repro ../../cdc-independent-evidence/baseline-rtl
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: cdc-historical-baseline-448dfdf-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: cdc-independent-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

  record-consumers:
    name: Current-head ports, BlackBox and UInt consumers
    needs: source-preflight
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/spinalhdl/docker:v1.2.0
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Authenticate the actual compiler head and record tools
        env:
          EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p cdc-consumer-evidence
          git rev-parse HEAD | tee cdc-consumer-evidence/head.txt
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"
          git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}' | tee cdc-consumer-evidence/tree.txt
          java -version 2>&1 | tee cdc-consumer-evidence/java-version.txt
          iverilog -V > cdc-consumer-evidence/iverilog-version.txt 2>&1
          yosys -V | tee cdc-consumer-evidence/yosys-version.txt
      - id: generate
        name: Require successful native generation twice with both plugins
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd repro/cdc-independent-parameters
          sbt -batch -no-colors 'runMain spinal.core.CdcConsumerSuccess out-consumers' 2>&1 | tee ../../cdc-consumer-evidence/generation.log
          sbt -batch -no-colors 'runMain spinal.core.CdcConsumerSuccess out-consumers-repeat' 2>&1 | tee ../../cdc-consumer-evidence/repeat.log
          cat out-consumers/BlackBox/CdcRecordBlackBox.v
          cat out-consumers/Value/CdcRecordValue.v
      - name: Same-artifact independent override simulation and synthesis
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.generate.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd repro/cdc-independent-parameters
          python3 check_consumers.py out-consumers out-consumers-repeat ../../cdc-consumer-evidence/simulation 2>&1 | tee ../../cdc-consumer-evidence/override-matrix.log
      - name: Exact construction-side rejection diagnostics
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.generate.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd repro/cdc-independent-parameters
          sbt -batch -no-colors 'runMain spinal.core.CdcConsumerSafety safety-consumers' 2>&1 | tee ../../cdc-consumer-evidence/safety.log
      - name: Tracked source remains unchanged by validation
        if: always()
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git diff --exit-code
          git diff --cached --exit-code
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: cdc-record-consumers-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: |
            cdc-consumer-evidence/
            repro/cdc-independent-parameters/out-consumers/
            repro/cdc-independent-parameters/out-consumers-repeat/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

output="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/increment-60f-regressions"
          predecessor="$output/predecessor-source"
          successor_inventory="$output/increment-61-test-inventory.json"
          inherited_inventory="$output/inherited-test-inventory.json"
          complete_inventory="$output/test-inventory.json"

          # The current Increment 61 bytes are already sealed independently.
          # Re-run that exact contract before projecting only its two new test
          # reports out of the frozen 60f inventory.
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py --self-test
          # The verified predecessor includes every already-qualified lane
          # suite on the composed successor, or the original integrated target
          # on Increment 61 alone. Only the two Increment 61 reports are removed.
          base=$(python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py --print-regression-base)
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$base" HEAD
          printf '%s\n' "$base" > "$output/inherited-source-head.txt"
          git worktree add --detach "$predecessor" "$base"
          trap 'git worktree remove --force "$predecessor"' EXIT

          python3 - "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" "$predecessor" "$successor_inventory" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json
          import shutil
          import sys
          import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

          current, predecessor, output = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
          projects = (
              "paramrtl",
              "frontend",
              "backends/verilog",
              "morphhdl",
              "morphir",
              "morphplugin",
              "core",
              "morphhdl-passes",
          )
          expected = {
              "morphhdl.Increment61CompatibilityMatrixTests": 4,
              "morphhdl.Increment61PerComponentPublicationTests": 16,
          }

          def require(condition, detail):
              if not condition:
                  raise RuntimeError(detail)

          for project in projects:
              source = current / project / "target/test-reports"
              target = predecessor / project / "target/test-reports"
              require(source.is_dir(), f"missing current test reports: {source}")
              target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
              shutil.copytree(source, target)

          reports = predecessor / "morphhdl/target/test-reports"
          observed = {}
          for name, count in expected.items():
              path = reports / f"TEST-{name}.xml"
              require(path.is_file(), f"missing Increment 61 suite report: {path.name}")
              suite = ET.parse(path).getroot()
              require(suite.tag == "testsuite" and suite.get("name") == name,
                      f"wrong Increment 61 suite identity: {path}")
              require(int(suite.get("tests", "0")) == count,
                      f"changed Increment 61 test count: {name}")
              require(all(int(suite.get(key, "0")) == 0
                          for key in ("failures", "errors", "skipped")),
                      f"failed or skipped Increment 61 suite: {name}")
              require(not list(suite.iter("failure")) and
                      not list(suite.iter("error")) and
                      not list(suite.iter("skipped")),
                      f"unsuccessful Increment 61 testcase: {name}")
              cases = suite.findall("testcase")
              case_names = [case.get("name") for case in cases]
              require(len(cases) == count and all(case_names) and
                      len(set(case_names)) == count,
                      f"incomplete Increment 61 testcase identities: {name}")
              observed[name] = count
              path.unlink()

          remaining = {
              path.name
              for path in reports.glob("TEST-morphhdl.Increment61*.xml")
          }
          require(not remaining,
                  "unexpected Increment 61 suite report(s): " + str(sorted(remaining)))
          output.write_text(json.dumps({
              "increment": "61",
              "tests": sum(observed.values()),
              "suites": sorted(observed),
              "counts": observed,
              "skipped": 0,
          }, indent=2) + "\n")
          print("Increment 61 successor inventory: 20 tests / 2 suites, zero failures/errors/skips")
          PY

          if test -f morphhdl/contracts/increment-59i-production-successor.json; then
            python3 -B morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-59i-regression-inventory.py prepare \
              --predecessor "$predecessor" --output "$output/increment-59i-test-inventory.json"
          else
            # Authenticate and validate all 37 added tests before removing only
            # their copied reports from the frozen predecessor catalog.
            python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-pr190-pr189-source-sync.py \
              --project-regressions "$predecessor" "$output/sequential-test-inventory.json"
          fi

          (
            cd "$predecessor"
            python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-60f-artifacts.py regressions \
              . "$inherited_inventory"
          )

          python3 - "$inherited_inventory" "$successor_inventory" "$complete_inventory" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json
          import sys

          inherited_path, successor_path, output_path = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
          inherited = json.loads(inherited_path.read_text())
          successor = json.loads(successor_path.read_text())
          morphhdl = inherited["morphhdl"]
          overlap = set(morphhdl["suites"]) & set(successor["suites"])
          if overlap:
              raise RuntimeError("Increment 61 suite overlaps inherited inventory: " + str(sorted(overlap)))
          morphhdl["tests"] += successor["tests"]
          morphhdl["suites"] = sorted(morphhdl["suites"] + successor["suites"])
          if morphhdl["skipped"] != 0 or successor["skipped"] != 0:
              raise RuntimeError("complete Increment 61 inventory contains skipped tests")
          output_path.write_text(json.dumps(inherited, indent=2) + "\n")
          total = sum(record["tests"] for record in inherited.values())
          print(f"60f + Increment 61 complete regressions: {total} non-skipped tests")
          PY
          if test -f morphhdl/contracts/increment-59i-production-successor.json; then
            python3 -B morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-59i-regression-inventory.py finish --output "$output"
          else
            # Add validated new suites back to the already checked old + Inc61
            # inventory. The original current-head XML is never edited.
            python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-pr190-pr189-source-sync.py \
              --combine-regressions "$complete_inventory" "$output/sequential-test-inventory.json"
          fi

edits.after:
name: Increment 61 per-component compatibility matrix

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - parameterized-verilog
      - agent/increment-61-one-file-per-component
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/increment-61-compatibility-matrix.yml'
      - 'morphhdl/contracts/increment-61-source-review.json'
      - 'morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py'
      - 'morphhdl/src/main/scala/morphhdl/MorphPerComponentPublication.scala'
      - 'morphhdl/src/main/scala/morphhdl/MorphVerilog.scala'
      - 'morphhdl/src/main/scala/morphhdl/integration/ExternalSpinalVerilog.scala'
      - 'morphhdl/src/main/scala/spinal/core/internals/MorphHdlExternalParameterizedVerilog.scala'
      - 'morphhdl/src/main/scala/spinal/core/internals/MorphHdlExternalEnumLocalizer.scala'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/scala/morphhdl/Increment61PerComponentPublicationTests.scala'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/scala/morphhdl/Increment61CompatibilityCatalog.scala'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/scala/morphhdl/Increment61CompatibilityMatrix.scala'
  pull_request:
    branches: [parameterized-verilog]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/increment-61-compatibility-matrix.yml'
      - 'morphhdl/contracts/increment-61-source-review.json'
      - 'morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py'
      - 'morphhdl/src/main/scala/morphhdl/MorphPerComponentPublication.scala'
      - 'morphhdl/src/main/scala/morphhdl/MorphVerilog.scala'
      - 'morphhdl/src/main/scala/morphhdl/integration/ExternalSpinalVerilog.scala'
      - 'morphhdl/src/main/scala/spinal/core/internals/MorphHdlExternalParameterizedVerilog.scala'
      - 'morphhdl/src/main/scala/spinal/core/internals/MorphHdlExternalEnumLocalizer.scala'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/scala/morphhdl/Increment61PerComponentPublicationTests.scala'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/scala/morphhdl/Increment61CompatibilityCatalog.scala'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/scala/morphhdl/Increment61CompatibilityMatrix.scala'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: increment-61-compatibility-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  qualify:
    name: Compatibility and tools Scala ${{ matrix.scala }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        scala: ['2.12.18', '2.13.12']
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/spinalhdl/docker:v1.2.0
    env:
      SCALA_VERSION: ${{ matrix.scala }}
      COURSIER_REPOSITORIES: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2
      COURSIER_CACHE: /sbt/.cache/coursier/v1
      JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS: '-Xmx5G -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=4'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require exact reviewed source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py --self-test
      - name: Bootstrap pinned SBT
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/increment-61-compatibility"
          mkdir -p "$output"
          version=$(sed -n 's/^sbt.version=//p' project/build.properties)
          test "$version" = '1.10.0'
          curl --fail --location --retry 5 --retry-all-errors \
            "https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/scala-sbt/sbt-launch/$version/sbt-launch-$version.jar" \
            -o "$output/sbt-launch.jar"
          printf '[repositories]\nlocal\nmaven-central: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2\n' > "$output/repositories"
      - name: Generate the complete per-component compatibility corpus
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/increment-61-compatibility"
          java -Xmx4G -Dsbt.log.noformat=true -Dsbt.supershell=false \
            -Dsbt.boot.directory=/sbt/.sbt/boot -Dsbt.global.base=/sbt/.sbt \
            -Dsbt.ivy.home=/sbt/.ivy2 -Duser.home=/sbt \
            -Dsbt.repository.config="$output/repositories" -Dsbt.override.build.repos=true \
            -jar "$output/sbt-launch.jar" "++$SCALA_VERSION" \
            'morph/Test/testOnly morphhdl.Increment61CompatibilityMatrixTests' \
            "morph/Test/runMain morphhdl.Increment61CompatibilityMatrixArtifacts $output/generated" \
            > "$output/sbt.log" 2>&1 || { tail -n 300 "$output/sbt.log"; exit 1; }
      - name: Strict Verilog-2001 compile, lint and synthesis for every roadmap family
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/increment-61-compatibility"
          compatibility="$output/generated"
          while IFS=$'\t' read -r case_id generated_top tool_top support_file; do
            test -n "$case_id" && test -n "$generated_top" && test -n "$tool_top"
            directory="$compatibility/$case_id"
            list="$directory/$generated_top.lst"
            test -s "$list"
            mapfile -t relative_sources < "$list"
            test "${#relative_sources[@]}" -gt 0
            sources=()
            for relative in "${relative_sources[@]}"; do
              test "$relative" = "$(basename "$relative")"
              test -s "$directory/$relative"
              sources+=("$directory/$relative")
            done
            if [ "$support_file" != '-' ]; then
              test "$support_file" = "$(basename "$support_file")"
              test -s "$directory/$support_file"
              sources+=("$directory/$support_file")
            fi
            timeout 120 iverilog -g2001 -Wall -Wimplicit -s "$tool_top" \
              -o "$output/$case_id.vvp" "${sources[@]}" \
              > "$output/$case_id-iverilog.log" 2>&1
            timeout 120 verilator --lint-only --language 1364-2001 -Wall -Wno-fatal \
              --top-module "$tool_top" "${sources[@]}" \
              > "$output/$case_id-verilator.log" 2>&1
            timeout 180 yosys -Q -T -ql "$output/$case_id-yosys.log" -p "
              read_verilog -defer -noautowire ${sources[*]};
              hierarchy -check -simcheck -top $tool_top;

  cross-scala:
    name: Cross-Scala compatibility publication bytes
    needs: qualify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:

jobs:

    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'pull_request_review' ||
      (github.event.review.state == 'commented' &&
       github.event.review.user.login == github.repository_owner &&
       github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
       github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'parameterized-verilog' &&
       github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'agent/lane-when-expression-inlining' &&
       github.event.review.commit_id == github.event.pull_request.head.sha &&
       github.event.review.body == format('/qualify-increment61 {0}', github.event.pull_request.head.sha))
    name: Exact source and inherited audit composition
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify Increment 61 and the unchanged predecessor source contracts
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/increment-61-source"
          predecessor="$output/predecessor"
          mkdir -p "$output"
          git rev-parse HEAD > "$output/head.txt"
          git archive HEAD | gzip > "$output/source.tar.gz"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/test-increment-61-publication-artifacts.py
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py | tee "$output/review.log"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py --self-test | tee -a "$output/review.log"
          base=$(python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-source-review.py --print-base)
          git worktree add --detach "$predecessor" "$base"
          trap 'git worktree remove --force "$predecessor"' EXIT
          (
            cd "$predecessor"
            python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-60g-source-scope.py
            python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-60f-equivalence-closure.py --source-only
          ) | tee "$output/inherited.log"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-native-source-preservation.py | tee "$output/native.log"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-native-source-overlay.py | tee "$output/overlay.log"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: increment-61-source
          path: target/increment-61-source
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

  publication:
    needs: source
    name: Publication, tools and equivalence Scala ${{ matrix.scala }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        scala: ['2.12.18', '2.13.12']
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/spinalhdl/docker:v1.2.0
    env:
      SCALA_VERSION: ${{ matrix.scala }}
      COURSIER_REPOSITORIES: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2
      COURSIER_CACHE: /sbt/.cache/coursier/v1
      JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS: '-Xmx5G -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=4'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Bootstrap pinned SBT
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/increment-61"
          mkdir -p "$output"
          version=$(sed -n 's/^sbt.version=//p' project/build.properties)
          test "$version" = '1.10.0'
          curl --fail --location --retry 5 --retry-all-errors \
            "https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/scala-sbt/sbt-launch/$version/sbt-launch-$version.jar" \
            -o "$output/sbt-launch.jar"
          printf '[repositories]\nlocal\nmaven-central: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2\n' > "$output/repositories"
      - name: Run focused tests and generate independent deterministic artifacts
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/increment-61"
          java -Xmx4G -Dsbt.log.noformat=true -Dsbt.supershell=false \
            -Dsbt.boot.directory=/sbt/.sbt/boot -Dsbt.global.base=/sbt/.sbt \
            -Dsbt.ivy.home=/sbt/.ivy2 -Duser.home=/sbt \
            -Dsbt.repository.config="$output/repositories" -Dsbt.override.build.repos=true \
            -jar "$output/sbt-launch.jar" "++$SCALA_VERSION" \
            'morph/Test/testOnly morphhdl.Increment61PerComponentPublicationTests' \
            "morph/Test/runMain morphhdl.Increment61PerComponentPublicationArtifacts $output/generated-a" \
            "morph/Test/runMain morphhdl.Increment61PerComponentPublicationArtifacts $output/generated-b" \
            > "$output/sbt.log" 2>&1 || { tail -n 300 "$output/sbt.log"; exit 1; }
          diff -ru "$output/generated-a" "$output/generated-b" > "$output/fresh-generation.diff"
      - name: Strict Verilog-2001 compile, lint, synthesis and split equivalence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/increment-61"
          split="$output/generated-a/split"
          combined="$output/generated-a/consolidated/Increment61Top.v"
          files=("$split/Increment61Leaf.v" "$split/Increment61Top.v")
          test "$(cat "$split/Increment61Top.lst")" = $'Increment61Leaf.v\nIncrement61Top.v'
          iverilog -g2001 -s Increment61Top -o "$output/split.vvp" "${files[@]}"
          iverilog -g2001 -s Increment61Top -o "$output/combined.vvp" "$combined"
          verilator --lint-only --language 1364-2001 --top-module Increment61Top "${files[@]}"
          verilator --lint-only --language 1364-2001 --top-module Increment61Top "$combined"
          yosys -q -p "read_verilog -noautowire ${files[*]}; hierarchy -check -top Increment61Top; proc; memory; flatten; opt; check -assert; stat" \
            > "$output/split-yosys.log"
          yosys -q -p "read_verilog -noautowire $combined; hierarchy -check -top Increment61Top; proc; memory; flatten; opt; check -assert; stat" \
            > "$output/combined-yosys.log"
          for widths in '1 1' '5 5' '7 13' '32 3'; do
            read -r left right <<<"$widths"
            work="$output/equiv-${left}-${right}"
            cat > "$work.ys" <<YOSYS
          read_verilog -noautowire ${files[*]}
          chparam -set LEFT_WIDTH $left -set RIGHT_WIDTH $right Increment61Top
          hierarchy -check -top Increment61Top
          proc
          memory
          flatten
          opt
          rename Increment61Top gold
          design -stash gold
          design -reset
          read_verilog -noautowire $combined
          chparam -set LEFT_WIDTH $left -set RIGHT_WIDTH $right Increment61Top
          hierarchy -check -top Increment61Top
          proc
          memory
          flatten
          opt
          rename Increment61Top gate
          design -stash gate
          design -reset
          design -copy-from gold -as gold gold
          design -copy-from gate -as gate gate
          equiv_make gold gate equiv
          prep -top equiv
          equiv_simple
          equiv_status -assert
          YOSYS
            yosys -q -s "$work.ys" > "$work.log"
          done
      - name: Exercise missing, duplicate and wrong-file publication controls
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/increment-61"
          split="$output/generated-a/split"
          if iverilog -g2001 -s Increment61Top -o /dev/null "$split/Increment61Top.v" > "$output/missing.log" 2>&1; then
            echo 'missing child definition unexpectedly compiled' >&2; exit 1
          fi
          cat "$split/Increment61Leaf.v" "$split/Increment61Leaf.v" > "$output/duplicate-leaf.v"
          if iverilog -g2001 -s Increment61Top -o /dev/null "$output/duplicate-leaf.v" "$split/Increment61Top.v" > "$output/duplicate.log" 2>&1; then
            echo 'duplicate child definition unexpectedly compiled' >&2; exit 1
          fi
          python3 - "$split" "$output" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, shutil, sys
          split, output = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
          expected = {"Increment61Leaf.v": "Increment61Leaf", "Increment61Top.v": "Increment61Top"}
          pattern = re.compile(r"(?m)^\s*module\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*)\b")
          def check(root):
              for name, module in expected.items():
                  found = pattern.findall((root / name).read_text())
                  if found != [module]:
                      raise RuntimeError((name, module, found))
          check(split)
          wrong = output / "wrong-file"
          wrong.mkdir()
          shutil.copyfile(split / "Increment61Leaf.v", wrong / "Increment61Top.v")
          shutil.copyfile(split / "Increment61Top.v", wrong / "Increment61Leaf.v")
          try:
              check(wrong)
          except RuntimeError as error:
              (output / "wrong-file.log").write_text(str(error) + "\n")
          else:
              raise RuntimeError("wrong-file publication mutation was not detected")
          PY
      - name: Record exact source inventory
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/increment-61"
          git rev-parse HEAD > "$output/head.txt"
          find "$output/generated-a" -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > "$output/generated.sha256"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-publication-artifacts.py record \
            "$output" "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" "$SCALA_VERSION" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: increment-61-diagnostics-${{ matrix.scala }}-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: target/increment-61
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Upload qualified publication only after every producer gate
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: success()
        with:
          name: increment-61-qualified-${{ matrix.scala }}
          path: |
            target/increment-61/generated-a
            target/increment-61/generated-b
            target/increment-61/head.txt
            target/increment-61/publication-proof.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
          overwrite: true

  cross-scala:
    needs: publication
    name: Cross-Scala generated-byte determinism
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: increment-61-qualified-2.*
          path: target/increment-61-cross
      - name: Compare complete generated publication sets
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root=target/increment-61-cross
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-61-publication-artifacts.py compare \
            "$root" "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" \
            | tee target/increment-61-cross-proof.json
          left="$root/increment-61-qualified-2.12.18/generated-a"
          right="$root/increment-61-qualified-2.13.12/generated-a"
          test -d "$left" && test -d "$right"
          diff -ru "$left" "$right" | tee "$root/cross-scala.diff"

          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive
      - name: Verify pinned tools and clean source compilation
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}'
          yosys -V
          yosys -V | grep -Eq '^Yosys 0\.41([ +]|$)'
          verilator --version
          iverilog -V
          java -version
          python3 repro/independent-parameters/qualify.py --scala '${{ matrix.scala }}'

        if: always()

          name: independent-parameter-regressions-${{ matrix.scala }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

            independent-parameter-evidence/
            target/independent-domains-*/

          if-no-files-found: error

    needs: source-contracts
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/spinalhdl/docker:v1.2.0
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive
      - name: Exact standalone reproducer and byte-for-byte publication
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p independent-parameter-evidence
          git rev-parse HEAD | tee independent-parameter-evidence/head.txt
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}'
          cd repro/independent-parameters
          test "$(cat project/build.properties)" = 'sbt.version=1.10.0'
          sbt -batch 'runMain repro.IndependentParameterRepro out' 2>&1 | tee ../../independent-parameter-evidence/generation.log
          sbt -batch 'runMain repro.IndependentParameterRepro out-repeat' 2>&1 | tee ../../independent-parameter-evidence/repeat.log
          cmp out/RecordWidth.v out-repeat/RecordWidth.v
          sha256sum out/RecordWidth.v out-repeat/RecordWidth.v | tee ../../independent-parameter-evidence/publication-sha256.txt
      - name: Same-artifact overrides, every bit, hierarchy, branches and legality
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd repro/independent-parameters
          python3 check.py 2>&1 | tee ../../independent-parameter-evidence/native-matrix.log
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: independent-parameter-native-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: |
            independent-parameter-evidence/
            repro/independent-parameters/out/
            repro/independent-parameters/out-repeat/
            repro/independent-parameters/results/

edits.after:
name: Lane and when expression inlining qualification

on:
  push:
    branches: [agent/lane-when-expression-inlining, parameterized-verilog]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/lane-when-expression-diagnostic.yml'
      - 'core/src/main/**'
      - 'core/src/test/scala/spinal/core/internals/VerilogEmitterExpressionInliningTests.scala'
      - 'morphhdl/src/main/**'
      - 'morphhdl-passes/examples/**'
      - 'morphhdl-passes/src/main/**'
      - 'morphhdl/scripts/check-lane-when-inlining.py'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/scala/morphhdl/Lane*'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/scala/morphhdl/GenerateLaneExpressionExample.scala'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/scala/spinal/core/internals/LaneExpressionTraceWriter.scala'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/resources/lane-expression/**'
  pull_request:
    branches: [parameterized-verilog]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/lane-when-expression-diagnostic.yml'
      - 'core/src/main/**'
      - 'morphhdl/src/main/**'
      - 'morphhdl-passes/examples/**'
      - 'morphhdl-passes/src/main/**'
      - 'morphhdl/scripts/check-lane-when-inlining.py'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/scala/morphhdl/Lane*'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/scala/morphhdl/GenerateLaneExpressionExample.scala'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/scala/spinal/core/internals/LaneExpressionTraceWriter.scala'
      - 'morphhdl/src/test/resources/lane-expression/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  qualify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        scala: ['2.12.18', '2.13.12']
    env:
      SBT_TEST_PARALLEL: '0'
      JVM_OPTS: '-Xmx5G -Xss4M -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
      - uses: sbt/setup-sbt@v1
      - name: Install strict compile, four-state simulation, lint, and synthesis tools
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y iverilog verilator yosys
      - name: Independently rebuild the unchanged reported compiler baseline
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          baseline="$RUNNER_TEMP/lane-when-baseline"
          evidence="$RUNNER_TEMP/lane-when-evidence"
          mkdir -p "$evidence"
          git rev-parse HEAD 'HEAD^{tree}' > "$evidence/candidate-identity.txt"
          git worktree add --detach "$baseline" 3b547ae5622ae212c17f6e67cc96924127a46a41
          for file in GenerateLaneExpressionExample LaneConditionCoverageExample LaneReceiverCoverageExample LaneInliningRegressionWriter; do
            cp "morphhdl/src/test/scala/morphhdl/$file.scala" "$baseline/morphhdl/src/test/scala/morphhdl/"
          done
          cd "$baseline"
          git rev-parse HEAD 'HEAD^{tree}' > "$evidence/baseline-identity.txt"
          git diff --exit-code -- core/src/main lib/src/main idslplugin/src/main morphplugin/src/main morphhdl/src/main morphir/src/main morphruntime/src/main frontend/src/main backends/verilog/src/main paramrtl/src/main morphhdl-passes/src morphhdl-passes/examples
          sbt '++${{ matrix.scala }}' "morph/Test/runMain morphhdl.LaneInliningRegressionWriter $evidence/before" 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/baseline-sbt.log"
      - name: Compile and test the actual current production source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="$RUNNER_TEMP/lane-when-evidence"
          sbt '++${{ matrix.scala }}' \
            'core/Test/testOnly spinal.core.internals.VerilogEmitterExpressionInliningTests spinal.core.internals.VerilogDeclarationPolicyStorageTests' \
            'morph/Test/testOnly morphhdl.LaneWhenInliningRegressionTests spinal.core.MorphVerilogExpressionInliningTests morphhdl.examples.NativeWireExpressionCodecTests spinal.core.BooleanWidthNormalizationTests' \
            "morph/Test/runMain morphhdl.LaneInliningRegressionWriter $evidence/after" \
            "morph/Test/runMain morphhdl.GenerateLaneExpressionExample $evidence/plain" \
            "morph/Test/runMain spinal.core.internals.LaneExpressionTraceWriter $evidence/trace" \
            2>&1 | tee "$evidence/candidate-sbt.log"
          cmp "$evidence/plain/LaneExpressionExample.v" "$evidence/trace/rtl/LaneExpressionExample.v"
          cmp "$evidence/plain/LaneExpressionExample.v" "$evidence/after/first/default/lane/design.v"
      - name: Check final RTL, parameter widths, simulations, proofs, and real RTL mutations
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="$RUNNER_TEMP/lane-when-evidence"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-lane-when-inlining.py \
            --before "$evidence/before" --after "$evidence/after" --output "$evidence/validation"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: lane-when-qualification-${{ matrix.scala }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/lane-when-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
  cross-scala:
    needs: qualify
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: lane-when-qualification-2.12.18
          path: scala212
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: lane-when-qualification-2.13.12
          path: scala213
      - name: Require identical exact source identities and all emitted artifacts
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cmp scala212/candidate-identity.txt scala213/candidate-identity.txt
          cmp scala212/baseline-identity.txt scala213/baseline-identity.txt
          diff -ru scala212/before scala213/before
          diff -ru scala212/after scala213/after

  compatibility:
    name: Lane Binary source and concrete parity Scala ${{ matrix.scala_version }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 300
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/spinalhdl/docker:v1.2.0
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        scala_version:
        - 2.12.18
        - 2.13.12
    steps:
    - name: Check out exact head with complete history
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        fetch-depth: 0
        submodules: recursive
    - name: Record and authenticate the exact qualification revision
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        mkdir -p "$EVIDENCE_DIR"
        git rev-parse HEAD 'HEAD^{tree}' > "$EVIDENCE_DIR/source-identity.txt"
        test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}"
        python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-62-wa08-source-overlay.py
        python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-lane-when-source-scope.py
    - name: Prove JVM compatibility with the selected upstream baseline
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        {
          bash morphhdl/scripts/check-binary-compatibility.sh --scala-version "${{ matrix.scala_version }}"
        } 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE_DIR/prove-jvm-compatibility-with-the-selected-upstream-baseline.log"
      shell: bash
    - name: Prove MorphHDL report ABI against the exact prior increment
      shell: bash
      env:
        BASE_COMMIT: 7f355a859e7e88ca343e1ff82f261fb47b3311d0
        SCALA_VERSION: ${{ matrix.scala_version }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        {
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "$BASE_COMMIT"
          test "$(git rev-parse --verify "$BASE_COMMIT^{commit}")" = "$BASE_COMMIT"
          compatibility_root="$(mktemp -d /tmp/morphhdl-report-abi.XXXXXX)"
          baseline_root="$compatibility_root/baseline"
          cleanup() {
            status=$?
            git worktree remove --force "$baseline_root" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            rm -rf -- "$compatibility_root"
            return "$status"
          }
          trap cleanup EXIT
          git worktree add --quiet --detach "$baseline_root" "$BASE_COMMIT"

          (
            cd "$baseline_root"
            sbt -batch "++$SCALA_VERSION" "morph / Compile / packageBin"
          )
          sbt -batch "++$SCALA_VERSION" "morph / Compile / packageBin"

          scala_binary="${SCALA_VERSION%.*}"
          artifact() {
            root=$1
            mapfile -t candidates < <(find \
              "$root/morphhdl/target/scala-$scala_binary" \
              -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.jar' \
              ! -name '*-tests.jar' ! -name '*-sources.jar' ! -name '*-javadoc.jar' \
              | LC_ALL=C sort)
            test "${#candidates[@]}" = 1
            printf '%s\n' "${candidates[0]}"
          }
          baseline_jar="$(artifact "$baseline_root")"
          current_jar="$(artifact "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE")"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-jvm-binary-compatibility.py \
            --label "morph-report-$SCALA_VERSION" \
            --baseline "$baseline_jar" \
            --current "$current_jar"
        } 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE_DIR/prove-morphhdl-report-abi-against-the-exact-prior-increment.log"
    - name: Prove source linkage and ordinary SpinalVerilog parity
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        {
          bash morphhdl/scripts/check-concrete-spinalverilog-parity.sh --scala "${{ matrix.scala_version }}"
        } 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE_DIR/prove-source-linkage-and-ordinary-spinalverilog-parity.log"
      shell: bash
    - name: Prove the external inspection boundary against Increment 0
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        {
          bash morphhdl/scripts/check-external-spinal-boundary.sh "${{ matrix.scala_version }}"
        } 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE_DIR/prove-the-external-inspection-boundary-against-increment-0.log"
      shell: bash
    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      if: always()
      with:
        name: lane-compatibility-${{ matrix.scala_version }}
        path: ${{ env.EVIDENCE_DIR }}
        if-no-files-found: error
        retention-days: 14
    env:
      EVIDENCE_DIR: /tmp/lane-compatibility-evidence
      SBT_TEST_PARALLEL: '0'
  sbt-full:
    name: Lane SBT full suite Scala ${{ matrix.scala_version }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/spinalhdl/docker:v1.2.0
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        scala_version:
        - 2.12.18
        - 2.13.12
    steps:
    - name: Check out exact head
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        submodules: recursive
        fetch-depth: 0
    - name: Record and authenticate the exact qualification revision
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        mkdir -p "$EVIDENCE_DIR"
        git rev-parse HEAD 'HEAD^{tree}' > "$EVIDENCE_DIR/source-identity.txt"
        test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}"
        python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-62-wa08-source-overlay.py
        python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-lane-when-source-scope.py
    - name: Compile every production and test source
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        {
          sbt -batch "++${{ matrix.scala_version }}" compile Test/compile
        } 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE_DIR/compile-every-production-and-test-source.log"
      shell: bash
    - name: Run frontend canonical IR MorphHDL and native simulation suites
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        {
          sbt -batch "++${{ matrix.scala_version }}" frontend/test
          sbt -batch "++${{ matrix.scala_version }}" morphir/test
          sbt -batch "++${{ matrix.scala_version }}" morph/test
          sbt -batch "++${{ matrix.scala_version }}" \
            "tester/testOnly spinal.lib.CounterTester spinal.lib.SpinalSimStreamFifoTester spinal.lib.SpinalSimStreamFifoCCTester spinal.lib.SpinalSimStreamWidthAdapterTester"
        } 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE_DIR/run-frontend-canonical-ir-morphhdl-and-native-simulation-suites.log"
      shell: bash
    - name: Package fresh production modules and enforce retirement
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        {
          set -euo pipefail
          sbt -batch "++${{ matrix.scala_version }}" clean \
            frontend/package idslplugin/package morphir/package paramrtl/package \
            morphruntime/package morphplugin/package morph/package verilogBackend/package
          mapfile -t jars < <(find \
            frontend idslplugin morphir paramrtl morphruntime morphplugin morphhdl \
            backends/verilog \
            -regextype posix-extended -type f \
            -regex '.*/target/scala-[^/]+/[^/]+\.jar' | LC_ALL=C sort -u)
          test "${#jars[@]}" -ge 8
          arguments=()
          for jar in "${jars[@]}"; do
            arguments+=(--jar "$jar")
          done
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-58-retirement.py \
            --require-jar "${arguments[@]}"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-production-retirement.py \
            --require-jar "${arguments[@]}"
          python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-typed-layering-ir.py \
            --require-jar "${arguments[@]}"
        } 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE_DIR/package-fresh-production-modules-and-enforce-retirement.log"
    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      if: always()
      with:
        name: lane-sbt-full-${{ matrix.scala_version }}
        path: ${{ env.EVIDENCE_DIR }}
        if-no-files-found: error
        retention-days: 14
    env:
      EVIDENCE_DIR: /tmp/lane-sbt-full-evidence
      SBT_TEST_PARALLEL: '0'
  mill-full:
    name: Lane Mill affected full suite Scala ${{ matrix.scala_version }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/spinalhdl/docker:v1.2.0
    env:
      XDG_CACHE_HOME: /tmp/morphhdl-cache
      EVIDENCE_DIR: /tmp/lane-mill-full-evidence
      SBT_TEST_PARALLEL: '0'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        scala_version:
        - 2.12.18
        - 2.13.12
    steps:
    - name: Check out exact head
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        fetch-depth: 0
        submodules: recursive
    - name: Record and authenticate the exact qualification revision
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        mkdir -p "$EVIDENCE_DIR"
        git rev-parse HEAD 'HEAD^{tree}' > "$EVIDENCE_DIR/source-identity.txt"
        test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}"
        python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-increment-62-wa08-source-overlay.py
        python3 morphhdl/scripts/check-lane-when-source-scope.py
    - name: Install pinned Mill
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        {
          curl --fail --location --retry 5 --retry-all-errors \
            https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/com/lihaoyi/mill-dist/1.1.0/mill-dist-1.1.0.exe \
            --output /tmp/mill
          chmod +x /tmp/mill
        } 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE_DIR/install-pinned-mill.log"
      shell: bash
    - name: Compile and test all affected modules
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        {
          /tmp/mill \
            core[${{ matrix.scala_version }}].compile \
            frontend[${{ matrix.scala_version }}].compile \
            morphir[${{ matrix.scala_version }}].compile \
            paramrtl[${{ matrix.scala_version }}].compile \
            morphruntime[${{ matrix.scala_version }}].compile \
            morph[${{ matrix.scala_version }}].compile \
            verilogBackend[${{ matrix.scala_version }}].compile
          /tmp/mill frontend[${{ matrix.scala_version }}].test
          /tmp/mill morphir[${{ matrix.scala_version }}].test
          /tmp/mill morph[${{ matrix.scala_version }}].test
          /tmp/mill tester[${{ matrix.scala_version }}].testOnly \
            spinal.lib.CounterTester \
            spinal.lib.SpinalSimStreamFifoTester \
            spinal.lib.SpinalSimStreamFifoCCTester \
            spinal.lib.SpinalSimStreamWidthAdapterTester
        } 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE_DIR/compile-and-test-all-affected-modules.log"
      shell: bash
    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      if: always()
      with:
        name: lane-mill-full-${{ matrix.scala_version }}
        path: ${{ env.EVIDENCE_DIR }}
        if-no-files-found: error
        retention-days: 14
  qualification:
    name: Lane complete exact-head qualification
    needs:
    - qualify
    - cross-scala
    - compatibility
    - sbt-full
    - mill-full
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
    - name: Reject missing skipped cancelled or failed required jobs
      shell: bash
      env:
        QUALIFY: ${{ needs.qualify.result }}
        CROSS_SCALA: ${{ needs.cross-scala.result }}
        COMPATIBILITY: ${{ needs.compatibility.result }}
        SBT_FULL: ${{ needs.sbt-full.result }}
        MILL_FULL: ${{ needs.mill-full.result }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        for result in "$QUALIFY" "$CROSS_SCALA" "$COMPATIBILITY" "$SBT_FULL" "$MILL_FULL"; do
          test "$result" = success
        done
        printf '%s\n' 'LANE_COMPLETE_QUALIFICATION_PASS'

      - name: Native source guard and canonical manifest reproducibility
        run: |

/** A condition may be printed once per split process even when the native
    * expression has only one use. Keep this distinct from arbitrary expression
    * sharing: the ordinary complete sizing proof must already accept the exact
    * condition identity, and the complete subtree supplies a conservative
    * upper bound on the number of emitted process copies. This only declines
    * the condition-sharing request; other mandatory wrapping reasons survive.
    */
  private[internals] def redundantSharedCondition(
      component: Component,
      config: SpinalConfig,
      expression: Expression,
      approved: IdentityHashMap[Expression, java.lang.Boolean]
  ): Boolean = {
    if (!isEnabled(config) || !approved.containsKey(expression) ||
        expression.getTypeObject != TypeBool) return false
    val pending = ArrayBuffer(expression)
    var nodes = 0
    while (pending.nonEmpty) {
      val next = pending.remove(pending.size - 1)
      nodes += 1
      if (next == null || nodes > 64) return false
      next match {
        case _: BaseType =>
        case _ => next.foreachDrivingExpression(child => pending += child)
      }
    }
    var nativeConditions = 0
    var leaves = 0
    component.dslBody.walkStatements {
      case when: WhenStatement if when.cond eq expression =>
        nativeConditions += 1
        when.whenTrue.walkLeafStatements(_ => leaves += 1)
        when.whenFalse.walkLeafStatements(_ => leaves += 1)
      case _ =>
    }
    nativeConditions == 1 && leaves >= 1 && leaves <= 32 &&
      leaves.toLong * nodes <= 256
  }

  /** A late identity-sized unsigned resize can itself be a legal select base:
    * its printer emits only the existing declaration's reference. This is not
    * expression slicing or arithmetic reassociation. Every link must retain
    * the exact native type and fixed width; annotations and symbolic resizing
    * fail closed. The real source (including its name/protection) is untouched.
    */
  private[internals] def directSelectBase(
      component: Component,
      expression: Expression
  ): Option[BaseType] = {
    def follow(node: Expression, depth: Int): Option[BaseType] = {
      if (node == null || depth > 32) return None
      node match {
        case base: BaseType if (base.component eq component) &&
            (base.getTypeObject == TypeUInt || base.getTypeObject == TypeBits) &&
            base.getBitsWidth > 0 && !base.isAnalog && !base.isInOut &&
            ParameterizedWidth.expressionOf(base).isEmpty => Some(base)
        case resize: Resize if
            (resize.isInstanceOf[ResizeUInt] || resize.isInstanceOf[ResizeBits]) &&
            isUnannotated(resize) && resize.input != null && resize.size > 0 &&
            resize.size == resize.input.getWidth &&
            resize.getTypeObject == resize.input.getTypeObject &&
            ParameterizedWidth.resizeExpressionOf(resize).isEmpty =>
          follow(resize.input, depth + 1)
        case _ => None
      }
    }
    follow(expression, 0)
  }

The terminal log completed 59h's two positives/32 rejections, WA07B's
current/exact-B composition, the standalone full 60f source check, all
18 inherited 60f cases (two positives and sixteen rejections), and all
59f eight positives/122 rejection controls. The next original 59c inherited
harness was interrupted. The final artifact self-test and exact-parent
native/overlay audits had not run. The workflow was cancelled, not passed.

The full job log is the source for timestamps. The artifact preserves the
untimestamped audit log and exact head/tree, not a complete job-log archive.

## Scheduling-only repair

The same workflow partitions all 27 original audit commands, in their
original within-group order, into five groups: composition, 59h, WA07B,
60f, and 59f/59c. Every group gets the original committed-source preflight.
`max-parallel: 2` bounds active source jobs; `fail-fast: false` lets other
selected groups finish and retain evidence. Each group retains the original
240-minute job limit. No individual audit timeout, historical case,
negative diagnostic, Scala source, hardware gate, or native manifest changes.

Each literal original shell command has timestamped BEGIN/END markers.
Bash errexit/pipefail ensures a failed command cannot acquire its END marker
or be hidden by tee. A success-only step reauthenticates the live checkout
and creates a receipt for every expected command. Each attempt's artifact
has a distinct name; failures retain partial logs without a passing receipt.

The aggregate check keeps the old `source` check-run name. It runs even when
a dependency fails, explicitly requires `needs.source.result == success`,
and then validates the exact five-shard inventory, head/tree, workflow hash,
run identity, complete command markers, timestamps, and log digests. A
newer incomplete attempt cannot fall back to an older successful attempt.
A failed-job retry may retain earlier successful jobs from the SAME run and
head, with their original attempt numbers recorded. It never borrows an
old-head or different-run pass. After aggregation the four original native
and typed-overlay checks run on the same two frozen historical parents.

The scheduling/evidence tests execute the actual generated shell blocks
with synthetic child commands. They exercise success, nonzero exits,
missing and malformed receipts, stale/mixed source, cancellations, duplicate
markers, and retry handling. They are not executions of the full inherited
source chain. The original command inventory is checked against the exact
969af59a workflow Git blob. Source-review and importer pins advance to retain
969af59a as an authenticated predecessor; verifier semantics do not change.

on the resulting sealed repair. Five successful replacements remain tied
to their own heads. Full CI, roadmap completion, and PR merge remain blocked

The interface profile is independent of the arithmetic and register graph.
An unmodified configuration retains the packed Vec interface;
`MorphNamedFieldVectors.enable(config)` selects named field vectors and
`disable(config)` restores the packed interface. Both return configuration
copies. The merged 60g policy remains the signedness default: signed scalar
declarations with proven minimal casts. `MorphSignedCasts.disable(config)`
selects declarations with retained casts, and
`MorphSignedDeclarations.disable(config)` selects legacy unsigned declarations.
These signedness choices are independent of the Vec interface layout. Ordinary
concrete `SpinalVerilog` retains its native behavior.

## Consumer migration contract

Choose one interface profile for the complete generated hierarchy, then update
external instance connections to that profile. For a nested field, the named
port has the product of its exact scalar width and its outer-to-inner Vec
depths. The last axis varies fastest and coordinate zero occupies the least
significant slice. The
[59c layout and naming contract](increment-59c-named-field-vectors.md) continues
to define escaped names, collisions, directions and signed scalar boundaries.

| Consumer | Required connection |
| --- | --- |
| Existing packed Vec port | Keep the default or explicitly disable named fields; preserve the existing native field order and logical element stride. |
| Named recursive field vector | Connect each published field port separately; retain every independent Vec axis in its width and index formula. |
| Standalone result Bundle | Connect its ordinary scalar result leaves; the field-vector option adds no Vec axis to a Bundle. |
| Signed field inside a Vec | Treat the complete transport vector as packed bits and retain the native signed boundary of each selected scalar element. |
| Generated child | Forward the exact typed actuals in the parent context and use the same publication profile in parent and child. |

Compatibility adapters contain only slices, concatenations and wire
connections. They do not repeat callback arithmetic, choose a reduction tree,
insert registers or reinterpret reset/enable priority. Widening stages use the
retained recursive layout for logical offsets: changing a leaf width does not
replace an inner Vec depth with its finite carrier capacity.

`f43100e4899593eb5c9e78537a4dcf6f53f9c30f` and the completed Increment 61 target
`27af65abbee0d2334d6be7a6e4e2408b8af32fd9`, in that exact parent order. It does not
replace the published seal's history with another child of the original 59i
predecessor. The cumulative source inventory still uses
`954d9b2763b064dba60af71ad8fa509a9d7cada8` for existing historical projections.

Schema 1 and schema 2 retain their original rules. Schema 3 adds a fixed
`previous_seal` certificate and the complete target delta from the actual common
base, `61d1fe0dcac0b52856620944a2d7426fd1390a48`. The previous seal, source parent,
tree, manifest digest and normalized verifier digest are fixed code anchors,
not permissions inferred from a branch name or an editable receipt.

The unsealed continuation source must retain the previous manifest verbatim.
Its direct-child seal may change exactly the manifest and the verifier's single
manifest-hash slot. The new manifest binds every cumulative source change
except that separately authenticated manifest transition: paths, modes,
before/after hashes and reversible byte spans. Target-only changes must match
the explicit reconciliation inventory. An unchanged gap cannot be silently
included in a reviewed edit span.

Descendants retain the existing limited documentation transition. One normal
GitHub merge is allowed only when its target is an ancestor of the fixed,
reviewed target and its tree exactly equals the sealed feature tree. A newer
target, second integration merge, competing seal, or changed source requires a
new review; it cannot reuse this certificate.

## Both original certificates remain active

The continuation verifier authenticates the original 59i verifier at `f43100e4`
and the original Increment 61 verifier at `27af65ab` before executing either.
Each executes from a detached worktree containing only that fixed Git tree.
No current file, development import override, or fabricated result is inserted.
The worktree's HEAD, index and tracked files are checked afterward. Successful
immutable-object audits may be cached within a process; current manifest,
verifier, HEAD, index and worktree verification are not cached as authorization.

Increment 61's contract stays byte-identical to the target's certificate. Its
current reader first verifies the full schema-3 continuation and then runs the
unchanged, frozen Increment 61 certificate. Its self-test additionally executes
the original self-tests on that frozen target. This establishes source
composition, not that historical runtime tests qualify the new union.

WA-10 audits need an additional view of Increment 61's certified predecessor,
